bulletins.summary: The air conditioning dye injection tool kit has been developed to aid in identifying the location of air conditioning refrigerant leaks. The procedures outlined in this Service Bulletin aid in locating, inspecting, and repairing refrigerant leaks.

Frequently Asked Questions SPECIAL SERVICE CAMPAIGN 25TC03 Certain 2023 Model Year Corolla Cross Certain 2023 Model Year Corolla Cross HV Certain 2023 Model Year bZ4x Certain 2021-2023 Model Year Sienna HV TSS 3.0 Forward Recognition Camera Software Update

Included vehicles are equipped with Toyota Safety Sense (TSS) 3.0, which includes the Pre-Collision System (PCS), which uses the forward recognition camera. In rare cases, a software programming issue can damage the forward recognition camera. This will result in the Pre-Collision System not working the next time the car is started.
